decisions.reason: As a height-adjustable desk system it extends the firm's core office furniture knowledge, fits the move toward flexible workplaces, and the firm's own R&D makes continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.
A chair family is very close to the firm's established competence in premium seating and configurable interiors, so management can readily learn from market feedback and keep it in the range.

Although more accessory-like, the floor cushions still build on the firm's interior and material expertise, so with in-house R&D and a broad portfolio the firm is more likely to retain and adapt them than to exit quickly.
A soft upholstered sofa is near the firm's lounge and living-room capabilities, and its clear 2019 launch support suggests a core-design product the firm would normally continue.
The high standing table is close to the firm's conference and workplace offer and benefits from strong related knowledge about commercial interiors, making continuation the likely choice.

The rug collection is the most distant from the firm's manufacturing and product knowledge, and despite strategic importance its weaker relatedness makes learning and commercial improvement harder, so it is the likeliest line to be discontinued.
